name: Order line-type FIXED AMOUNT vs BILLING ONLY on splits
what_it_tests: The Workday line-type reverse-lookup must distinguish quantity-split children (same product) from LIC/MAINT subsplit children (different product) so a quantity-split parent stays FIXED AMOUNT and is not mis-stamped BILLING ONLY
proc_mechanism: Fortra_OrderItem_Set_Workday_Contract_Line_Type V8 reverse-lookup compares child vs parent Product2; V9/V10 broke subsplit detection (always-true / undistinguished)
expected_behavior: Quantity-split parent (qty>1 -> N qty=1, same product) stays FIXED AMOUNT (revenue recognized); only LIC/MAINT subsplit parent (different products) -> BILLING ONLY
test_setup: Order: 3x Perpetual @3675 (parent qty=3 + 3 children qty=1 same product), expect FIXED AMOUNT

run3_result.actual: Order 00095498 (801WC00000kkTSnYAM): 3x 5250 Integrator (Is_Subsplit_Product__c=false) parent 802WC00000Onq1FYAR (Original_Order_Item__c=null) = FIXED AMOUNT; children 802WC00000Onq1GYAR + 802WC00000Onq1HYAR (Original_Order_Item__c=802WC00000Onq1FYAR) = FIXED AMOUNT. Subsplit control order 00095631 (801WC00000lpqBGYAY): Is_Subsplit_Product__c=true lines (Automate Maintenance Add Ons 802WC00000PTQKEYA5, Advanced Reporting Suite 802WC00000PTQK5YAP/802WC00000PTQK6YAP, Automate Maintenance Add Ons 802WC00000PTQK8YAP) all = FIXED AMOUNT BILLING ONLY. Non-subsplit lines on same order = FIXED AMOUNT / PREPAID / USAGE BASED. Active flow V11 (301WC00000kUYVFYA4) confirmed via tooling API.
run3_result.evidence: Order 00095498 (qty-split, FIXED AMOUNT): https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Order/801WC00000kkTSnYAM/view | Parent OI 802WC00000Onq1FYAR, Children 802WC00000Onq1GYAR/802WC00000Onq1HYAR all = FIXED AMOUNT. Order 00095631 (subsplit control, BILLING ONLY): https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Order/801WC00000lpqBGYAY/view | Is_Subsplit_Product__c=true OIs: 802WC00000PTQKEYA5, 802WC00000PTQK5YAP, 802WC00000PTQK6YAP, 802WC00000PTQK8YAP all = FIXED AMOUNT BILLING ONLY. Active flow confirmed tooling: V11 Status=Active Id=301WC00000kUYVFYA4. Metadata: Data/sc3473/e07_validation/unpackaged/flows/Fortra_OrderItem_Set_Workday_Contract_Line_Type.flow
run3_result.notes: This scenario validates flow Fortra_OrderItem_Set_Workday_Contract_Line_Type, NOT a V21 pricing-procedure step. Active version is V11 (not V8/V9/V10). V11 abandons Original_Order_Item__c reverse-lookup entirely; Decision_Is_Subsplit gates purely on Product2.Is_Subsplit_Product__c (true -> BILLING ONLY; false -> does NOT stamp BILLING ONLY, routes to FIXED AMOUNT for Perpetual).
